references.text: A direct parallel confirming Reuel's sons and the Edomite genealogy in two different Bible books.
Establishes the family relationship between Esau, Basemath, and Reuel, explaining the origin of the chiefs mentioned in the source verse.
Places Reuel within the broader context of Esau's sons to understand his role among the patriarchs of Edom.
Concludes the list of Edomite chiefs and confirms Esau as the ancestor, parallel to the structure in the source verse.
Expands the list of Edomite chiefs and shows the overall structure of Esau's descendants.
